paite: Huchiin, lei leh van a tung ua omte tengteng toh zoh ahita hi.
english: The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array.

paite: Huan, Pathianin ni sagih niin a nasep a zoua; ni sagih niin a nasep tengteng a khawl santa hi.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

paite: Huchiin, Pathianin ni sagih ni a vualzawla, atangta hi: huai nia Pathianin a siam leh a bawl a nasep tengteng a khawl san jiakin.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work which he had created and made.

paite: Lei leh van a bawla a om lai ua a suante uh hiaite ahi uhi, Toupa Pathianin lei leh van a bawl niin.
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. God made the earth and the heavens.

paite: Huan, leia loupa himhim leiah a om naikei ua, leia anteh himhim leng a pou naikei uhi; Toupa Pathianiin lah leitungah vuah a zu sak nai keia, leilet dingin pasal leng a om nai sam kei hi;
english: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

paite: A hihhangin leia kipanin mei a hongsuaka, leitung tengteng a nom sak hi.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin leitunga leivuiin mi a bawla, a nakvangte ah hinna hu a ha luta; huchiin, mi mihing a hong hita hi.
english: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin suahlamah, Eden ah, huan a bawla; a pasal bawl huaiah a omsakta hi.
english: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

paite: Huan, leitunga kipanin Toupa Pathianin sing mithip tak leh nek tuak chiteng a pou saka; hinna sing leng huan laizangah a pou sak hi, a sia leh a pha theihna sing leng.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the middle of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

paite: Huan, Eden akipanin huan nomsak dingin lui a luang paisuaka; huaia kipanin a ka jaka, ka li a hong hita hi.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became four heads.

paite: A khatna min Pison ahi: huaipen Havila gam tengteng kualkhumlui ahi, huailaiah dangkaeng a om;
english: The name of the first is Pishon: this is the one which flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

paite: Huai gama dangkaeng hoih taka hi; huailaiah bedolak leh onik suang a om.
english: and the gold of that land is good. There is aromatic resin and the onyx stone.

paite: Huan, lui nihna Gihon ahi; huaimah Kus gam tengteng kualkhumlui ahi.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon: the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

paite: Huan, lui thumna min Hiddekel ahi; huai bel Assuria gam suahlama luang ahi. Huan, lui lina tuh Euphrates ahi.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel: this is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin pasal a pia, Eden huanah a kem ding leh a veng dingin a koihta hi.
english: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, pasal kiangah, Huana sing chiteng gahte na utut na ne thei hi;
english: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat;

paite: A sia leh a pha theihna sing gah bel na ne ding ahi kei; na nek leh na nek ni mahin na si ngei ding ahi, chiin, thu a pia.
english: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it; for in the day that you eat of it you will surely die.”

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, Pasal amah kiaa a om a hoih kei; amah panpaih ding a kithuahpih dia kilawm ka bawlsak ding, a chi a.
english: Yahweh God said, “It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him.”

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin leitung akipanin gam sa chiteng leh tunga leng vasa chiteng a bawlta; a min ding ua bang sak ding ahia chih theihna din Adam kiangah a honpi khawm hi: huan, thil hing chiteng a min uh Adam in a na phuah a min uh ahi den hi.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature, that was its name.

paite: Huchiin, Adam in gan tengteng, tunga leng vasa tengteng gamsa chiteng a min uh a phuahsak chiat hi: a hihhangin Adam adingin panpih a kithuahpih dia kilawm a om kei hi.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper suitable for him.

paite: Huchiin, Toupa Pathianin nuamtakin Adam a ihmu saka, huchiin a ihmutaa; huan, a nakguh khat a laa, atang dingin sa a pang dimsak hi:
english: Yahweh God caused a deep sleep to fall on the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

paite: Huan, Toupa Pathianin, Adam akipana a lak nakguh numei dingin a bawla, Adam kiangah a honpita hi.
english: He made the rib, which Yahweh God had taken from the man, into a woman, and brought her to the man.

paite: Huan Adamin, hiai hial jaw ka guh bang guh neia, ka sa bang sa nei ngei ahi; pasal akipana lak khiak ahih jiakin, Numei, chih ding ahi ding, a chi hi.
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

paite: Huaijiakin pasalin a nu leh a pa a paisan dinga, a ji lamah a belh ding: huchiin sa khat a hong hita ding uh.Huan, Adam leh a ji a nih un vuaktangin a om ua, a zum tuan kei uh.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

paite: Huan, Adam leh a ji a nih un vuaktangin a om ua, a zum tuan kei uh.
english: They were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
